Marco (CSM): Likely bulk embeddings. I'll own customer comms.
Samir Eng: Short-term: route to low-cost embed model + batching. Config: route->tiny-embed, batch=64, cache=on, throttle=60rps.
Priya Finance: Without fix runway ~9d. I'll update 30-day forecast and propose alerts at 60/90%.
Nora Product: QBR slide: cause, immediate mitigations, savings estimate, long-term ops.
Leah CS: Actions: Marco->message customer (ETA 2pm), Samir->canary (ETA 1h), Priya->forecast (ETA 4pm), Nora->slide.
Marco (CSM): Draft sent; customer ACKs throttle + session, asked about temporary credits.
Samir Eng: Canary metrics: token_savings ~58%, latency +12ms, errors 0/300. Rolling to prod.
Priya Finance: If cushion provided, runway +7 days. I'll post numbers.
Leah CS: Perfect. We'll include numbers in QBR and mark renewal risk if cushion needed. Closing loop once forecast posted.
